create_replay_loader: create a PyTorch DataLoader for replay buffer sampling with n-step returns and discounting
build_replay_buffer_storage: build a ReplayBufferStorage to collect and persist RL episode transitions as compressed NPZ files
save_load_episode: save an episode dict to a compressed NPZ file or load one back into memory
sample_replay_buffer: sample n-step transition tuples from a ReplayBuffer IterableDataset with automatic episode fetching
compute_episode_length: compute the number of transitions in an episode dict by inspecting array shapes
